cmd_deploy_ctx_bad_app: Error of `atlas deploy`: the app name becomes a folder and a unit name on the host, so only lowercase letters, digits and dashes are allowed. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_ctx_multiple_targets: Error of `atlas deploy` when atlas.yaml has several targets and none was named; {known} is the comma-separated list. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_ctx_no_atlas_yaml: Context of every `atlas deploy` command: --dir (default the current folder) has no atlas.yaml up the tree. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_ctx_no_deploy_section: Context of `atlas deploy`: atlas.yaml has no `deploy:` key. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_ctx_unknown_target: Error of `atlas deploy` when the named target is not under deploy.targets; {known} is the comma-separated list of target names. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_dry_driver: Line of `atlas deploy --dry-run`: where the driver would be written on the host. Padded label.
cmd_deploy_dry_release: Line of `atlas deploy --dry-run`: the id the release would get. Padded label.
cmd_deploy_dry_sha256: Line of `atlas deploy --dry-run`: the checksum of the archive. Padded label.
cmd_deploy_dry_target: Line of `atlas deploy --dry-run`. Padded label so the values align.
cmd_deploy_guard_announce: Progress line of `atlas deploy` naming the new release, the one it replaces and how the commits differ; {delta} is one of the guard_delta_* messages.
cmd_deploy_guard_delta_ahead: Delta in the announce line: commits this deploy adds over the live release.
cmd_deploy_guard_delta_diverged: Delta in the announce line when the histories diverged and the person allowed it; the plural follows {behind}.
cmd_deploy_guard_delta_downgrade: Delta in the announce line: commits this deploy drops from the live release (an allowed downgrade).
cmd_deploy_guard_delta_same: Delta in the announce line when HEAD is the commit already deployed.
cmd_deploy_guard_delta_unknown: Delta in the announce line when the live commit is not in the local repo and the person allowed it.
cmd_deploy_guard_fetching: Progress line of `atlas deploy` (stderr, after a ▸): the commit the host serves is not in the local repo, so Atlas tries `git fetch origin <sha>`.
cmd_deploy_guard_read_host_failed: Error of `atlas deploy`: the probe that asks the host which release is live failed; {error} is the host's stderr. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_guard_refuse_diverged: First paragraph of the refusal when HEAD and the deployed commit are on different lines of history. {base} is the 7-character merge-base; the plural follows {behind}.
cmd_deploy_guard_refuse_diverged_no_base: Same as the diverged refusal when git finds no merge-base at all; the plural follows {behind}.
cmd_deploy_guard_refuse_downgrade: First paragraph of the refusal when HEAD is behind the deployed commit (stale checkout). {head} and {sha} are 7-character shas, {id} the live release id, {count} the commits it would drop.
cmd_deploy_guard_refuse_dropped: Heading of the list of commits (up to 10, one per line) a refused deploy would drop. The git command stays as typed.
cmd_deploy_guard_refuse_override: Last line of every refusal; {flag} is the override flag for that case (--allow-downgrade, --allow-diverged, --allow-unknown-base).
cmd_deploy_guard_refuse_shas: Two aligned lines of the refusal with the full shas: the local HEAD and the commit live on the host. Keep the alignment of the values.
cmd_deploy_guard_refuse_unknown_base: First paragraph of the refusal when the live commit is missing locally and `git fetch origin <sha>` did not bring it.
cmd_deploy_history_finished: Column header of `atlas deploy history`: when the run ended. Uppercase, padded by the caller.
cmd_deploy_history_mode: Column header of `atlas deploy history`: deploy or rollback. Uppercase, padded by the caller.
cmd_deploy_history_reason: Column header of `atlas deploy history`: the reason the host recorded. Uppercase.
cmd_deploy_history_release: Column header of `atlas deploy history`: the release id. Uppercase, padded by the caller.
cmd_deploy_history_result: Column header of `atlas deploy history`: how the run ended. Uppercase, padded by the caller.
cmd_deploy_history_secs: Column header of `atlas deploy history`: duration in seconds. Uppercase, padded by the caller.
cmd_deploy_invalid_release_id: Error of `atlas deploy rollback --to` and `logs`: the id is not YYYYMMDDHHMMSS-sha7. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_launch_detached: Printed on stderr after Ctrl-C while following a deploy: the run goes on on the host.
cmd_deploy_launch_driver_failed: Error of `atlas deploy`: the command that starts the driver detached failed. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_launch_lost_contact: Error of `atlas deploy` after five minutes without an answer from the host while following the log. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_launch_mkdir_failed: Error of `atlas deploy`: the release folder could not be created on the host. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_launch_no_flock: Error of `atlas deploy`: the host lacks `flock`, which the driver needs for its lock. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_launch_unreachable: Error of `atlas deploy`, `status`, `rollback`: ssh to the host failed; {error} is ssh's message. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_launch_write_failed: Error of `atlas deploy`: driver.sh or plan.sh could not be written on the host. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.

cmd_deploy_mode_deploy.description: The kind of a run in `atlas deploy history`: a new release was shipped.
cmd_deploy_mode_deploy.distinct: kind of run shown in the history table

cmd_deploy_mode_rollback.description: The kind of a run in `atlas deploy history`: `atlas deploy rollback`.
cmd_deploy_mode_rollback.distinct: kind of run shown in the history table

cmd_deploy_phase_failed.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. Final: the run or the release failed.
cmd_deploy_phase_failed.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_healthy.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. Final: every service passed its health checks after the swap; also the status of a healthy release.
cmd_deploy_phase_healthy.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_installing.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. The `install` command runs in the new release.
cmd_deploy_phase_installing.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_locked.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. Final: another deploy holds the lock on the host.
cmd_deploy_phase_locked.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_migrating.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. The `migrate` command runs in the new release.
cmd_deploy_phase_migrating.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_noop.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. Final: the commit was already current and healthy, nothing was swapped.
cmd_deploy_phase_noop.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_post_swap.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. The post_swap hook runs, after `current` moved.
cmd_deploy_phase_post_swap.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_pre_swap.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. The pre_swap hook runs, before `current` moves.
cmd_deploy_phase_pre_swap.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_preflight.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. The run is checking the host (disk, lock, flock).
cmd_deploy_phase_preflight.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_restarting.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. The services restart on the new release and are checked.
cmd_deploy_phase_restarting.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_rolled_back.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. Final: the last healthy release serves again.
cmd_deploy_phase_rolled_back.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_rolling_back.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. The new release failed its checks and the last healthy one is coming back.
cmd_deploy_phase_rolling_back.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_sealed.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. The release is unpacked, verified against its sha256 and read-only.
cmd_deploy_phase_sealed.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_swapped.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. `current` points at the new release.
cmd_deploy_phase_swapped.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_unknown.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. The host reported no phase, or a release with no recorded status.
cmd_deploy_phase_unknown.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_phase_uploaded.description: A phase (or release status) word of `atlas deploy` shown in status, history and the final verdict. The release archive is on the host.
cmd_deploy_phase_uploaded.distinct: state word shown in a line of the deploy output

cmd_deploy_pkg_artifact_missing: Error of `atlas deploy`: a path of deploy.artifact does not exist after the build. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_pkg_build_failed: Error of `atlas deploy`: the project's build command exited non-zero. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_pkg_ctx_build: Context: the shell could not start the project's `deploy.build` command.
cmd_deploy_pkg_ctx_compress: Context: writing or finishing the gzip stream of the archive failed.
cmd_deploy_pkg_ctx_create_artifact: Context of a failed file creation or `git archive` while packaging the release archive.
cmd_deploy_pkg_ctx_git: Context of a failed `git` call while packaging; the cause follows after `caused by:`.
cmd_deploy_pkg_ctx_tar: Context of a failed `tar` start while packaging an `artifact:` list.
cmd_deploy_pkg_ctx_tar_stderr: Context: tar started without its stderr pipe.
cmd_deploy_pkg_ctx_tar_stdout: Context: tar started without its stdout pipe.
cmd_deploy_pkg_ctx_tar_wait: Context: waiting for the tar process failed.
cmd_deploy_pkg_dirty: Error of `atlas deploy`: uncommitted changes would ship under a clean-looking sha. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_pkg_failed: Error while packaging: tar or git archive exited non-zero; {error} is its stderr. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_pkg_git_failed: Error while packaging: a git command exited non-zero; {args} is the git arguments, {error} its stderr. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_remote_ctx_create_file: Context: the local file a remote command streams its output into could not be created (it exists, or the folder is not writable).
cmd_deploy_remote_ctx_ssh: Context of a failed `ssh` start (not installed, or not on PATH).
cmd_deploy_remote_upload_failed: Error of `atlas deploy`: the archive upload failed after retries; {error} is ssh's last message. Lowercase: the CLI puts `error:` before it.
cmd_deploy_report_critical: Final verdict, after a ✗, of a run that failed and could not restore the last healthy release.

cmd_deploy_report_failed.description: Final verdict of a failed or rolled back run, after a ✗; {reason} is what the host's driver recorded, shown as it is.

cmd_deploy_report_locked: Final verdict, after a ✗, when another deploy holds the host lock.

cmd_deploy_report_ok.description: Final verdict of a successful run, after a ✓: the phase it ended in (a cmd_deploy_phase_* message) and the release id.

cmd_deploy_status_current: Line of `atlas deploy status`: the release id `current` points at, or - when none. Padded label.
cmd_deploy_status_interrupted: Appended in bold red to the phase line of `atlas deploy status` when the last run stopped before a final phase and no deploy holds the lock.
cmd_deploy_status_lock: Line of `atlas deploy status` when a deploy holds the host lock; {holder} is who (user@host). Padded label.
cmd_deploy_status_lock_free: Line of `atlas deploy status` when no deploy holds the host lock. Padded label.
cmd_deploy_status_phase: Line of `atlas deploy status`: the phase of the last run ({phase} is a cmd_deploy_phase_* message). Padded label.
cmd_deploy_status_phase_reason: Same as status_phase when the host recorded a reason; {reason} is text written by the host's driver, shown as it is.

cmd_deploy_status_releases.description: Heading of the release list in `atlas deploy status` (one row per release id, sha and status).

cmd_deploy_status_service_active: Row of `atlas deploy status`: a service of the target that runs; {icon} is a colored check or cross for its health.
cmd_deploy_status_service_inactive: Row of `atlas deploy status`: a service of the target that does not run; {icon} is a colored check or cross for its health.

cmd_deploy_status_services.description: Heading of the service list in `atlas deploy status`.

cmd_deploy_status_target: First line of `atlas deploy status`: the target name, its host and folder. The label is padded so the values of the next lines align.

cmd_deploy_step_build.description: Progress line of `atlas deploy`: the project's own build command is about to run.

cmd_deploy_step_driver_running: Last progress line of `atlas deploy --no-follow`: the run id went to stdout and the driver continues on the host.
cmd_deploy_step_launch: Progress line of `atlas deploy`: the driver script is started detached on the host.
cmd_deploy_step_package: Progress line of `atlas deploy`: the release archive is built from {root}.
cmd_deploy_step_preflight: Progress line of `atlas deploy`: the host and folder are checked before uploading.
cmd_deploy_step_upload: Progress line of `atlas deploy`: the archive of release {id} is uploaded.
